texte.L’adiabatique consomme de l’eau précisém: Adiabatic cooling consumes water precisely at the hottest hours. Drought, for its part, restricts abstraction at the same hours. Each of the two criteria can be good: it is their COINCIDENCE that stops the installation, and that is what happened in Pantin on # June.
texte.L’air sec absorbe davantage de vapeur :: Dry air absorbs more vapour: at equal load, a tower evaporates better in an arid climate than in a humid one. Cooling efficiency therefore pushes towards water-stressed basins. In the United States, about two thirds of announced projects target the driest regions — affordable land, favourable taxation and evaporative efficiency converge there. Abstraction in water-stressed areas reaches a third at one large operator, nearly half at another.
texte.L’écart ne vient pas d’un dérapage d’exp: The gap does not come from an operational drift but from the ASSUMPTION: a water forecast built on an average climate does not describe consumption in a real summer.
